Enter the values printed by tools/extrac: Enter the values printed by tools/extract-credentials.js (see the README for how to capture a login). Tokens rotate automatically; the refresh token is valid ~30 days.
Every N seconds the adapter asks the dev: Every N seconds the adapter asks the device to push live values, as the app does while it is open. 0 disables it (values then only update when the device reports on its own). Minimum 5.
Keep the device clock in sync: Keep the device clock in sync
The device runs its charge and feed-in t: The device runs its charge and feed-in timers on its own clock, which drifts and doesn't follow daylight saving time. Set it from this host's clock (local time zone) when the adapter starts, every few hours (below), and whenever it is more than 30 s off (at most every 10 minutes).
0 = only when it is more than 30 s off. The clock drifts by about 10-20 s a day.
